pr_body:
Implements the first executable ADR 0121 capability slice without changing persisted project formats or Stable IDs.

- adds the shared authoring permission vocabulary
- adds a Scene authoring service over the existing AuthoringSession/Transaction boundary
- enforces exact revision + monotonic generation stale checks
- makes preview use commit-equivalent validation without mutation
- keeps one bulk apply call to one existing authoring transaction / undo entry
- adds transport-agnostic MCP handlers for project.describe, scene inspect/validate/preview/apply, entity find/inspect, and component schemas
- adds direct-service/MCP equivalence and stale/permission/atomicity tests

This deliberately keeps MCP transport and Editor process lifecycle out of engine-mcp, consistent with ADR 0015/0035/0121. Follow-up ADR 0121 slices can bind this adapter to the project-scoped live Editor endpoint and extend parity to the remaining authoring domains.
